_: Aliases on an ORDINARY (non-storyEvent, StartGameEnabled) quest — no Story Manager event needed. Demonstrates that forced / createObject fills and an alias OnActivate script all work on a normal always-running quest (previously the build only built aliases for storyEvent quests). Chain, all on game LOAD: the quest MFSE_Standalone auto-starts -> startUpStage 10 shows the objective 'Open the cache at your feet' AND its Player alias is forced to the player, then the Cache alias createObjects a vanilla chest AT the Player. That spawned chest carries the MFSE_AdvanceStage alias script. OPEN the chest -> OnActivate -> SetStage(20) -> objective completes + quest closes (RunOnce stops it respawning). In-game: load a save, a chest appears at your feet with a new journal objective; open it; the objective ticks done and the quest finishes.

quests.name: A Standing Errand
quests._: StartGameEnabled (default true) — NO storyEvent. Its aliases are built by BuildStandaloneQuestAliases. Player = forced player ref (Skyrim.esm:0x000014); Cache = createObject a vanilla small chest at the Player, carrying the advance-stage alias script.

stages.logEntry: A cache has appeared. Open it.

objectives.text: Open the cache at your feet

aliases.name: Cache
aliases._: Spawns a vanilla small chest at the player on quest start (= game load), carrying the alias OnActivate script that advances this quest to stage 20.
